relevant_sections: STEP 2-P5 — P1-Proxy Percentile-Fusion Relative Reranking Intervention (2026-08-30)
research_constitution.fold0_rule: The standing rule says not to read, materialize, or use Fold0 labels/data, and not to run Fold0 evaluation, except where an approved prompt clearly requires it. It does not grant a general Step3 confirmatory authorization.
research_constitution.public_rule: The standing rule says not to read or use public labels/gold; public inference is also prohibited unless an approved prompt clearly requires it. No general Step3 confirmatory authorization is stated.
research_constitution.research_folds_rule: Only validation queries in folds [1, 2, 3, 4] may be used under the standing constitution.
research_constitution.training_rule: Do not train, calibrate, or otherwise run an unapproved model workflow; the standing constitution is scoped to controlled research work on folds [1, 2, 3, 4].
research_constitution.confirmatory_rule: No section explicitly authorizes any partition for independent confirmatory evaluation. A future approved prompt is a condition for exceptions, not present authorization in this audit.
ambiguities: The Constitution does not define a reusable final-confirmatory role for Fold0 or public data. This audit therefore does not infer permanent prohibition or future permission; it records only that neither is presently explicitly authorized for Step3 execution.

blocking_ambiguities: The Constitution has no defined final-confirmatory role for Fold0/public; any future exception requires a fresh approved prompt and professor review.
LegalIR_warmup label availability and usage history were not safely established, but it is expressly outside the permitted F1-F4 scope.
notes: No model was loaded or run; no training, inference, scoring, threshold selection, or policy change occurred.
No Fold0, public, warm-up, synthetic, or other untouched-label values were opened. Only filenames, documented aggregate metadata, manifests, code/document references, and prior reports were audited.
F1-F4 remain non-confirmatory even though their folds were outer-held-out inside Step2: their reuse for K, proxy, beta, fusion, and policy decisions creates selection dependence.
A fresh professor review is required before any future Step3 action; this audit does not authorize Step3 execution.
